// BigInts held in any/unknown through Number(), `in`, structuredClone and
// assert.deepStrictEqual
import assert from "node:assert";
function t(name: string, f: () => unknown): void {
  try {
    console.log(name, f());
  } catch (e) {
    if (e instanceof Error) console.log(name, e.name + ": " + e.message);
  }
}
const x: any = 5n;
const u: unknown = 2n ** 70n;
console.log(Number(x), Number(u), Number(-(2n ** 1100n) as unknown));
t("plus", () => +x);
t("in", () => "foo" in x);
t("in2", () => "toString" in x);
const c1 = structuredClone(x);
const c2 = structuredClone({ a: 1n, b: [2n ** 65n] });
console.log(c1, c2, structuredClone(u) === u);
assert.deepStrictEqual(x, 5n);
assert.deepStrictEqual(u, 2n ** 70n);
const o: any = { k: u, l: [1n] };
assert.deepStrictEqual(o, { k: 2n ** 70n, l: [1n] });
console.log("deep ok");
t("deepFail", () => assert.deepStrictEqual(x, 6n));
